text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yo!
The URA Finals are starting soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So here's the plan! During the break,
how about doing some island training on Tracen Island?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Honed by Mother Nature, she unleashes her wild instincts to take on the URA Finals!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Quite nice, isn't it!
—And that's why, let's depart for the island!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's been decided that our training during the
URA Finals will take place on Tracen Island!
